question: On what ground can reality be affirmed in these cases despite their apparent contingency?
premises: An objection grants reality to these cases.
Their reality is said to be established.
This establishment is attributed to arising from consciousness.
inference: If these cases arise from consciousness, their reality may be affirmed on that basis.
uncertainties: The exact referent of eṣu depends on the preceding context.
